scope: Generic single-page public website worker and retrieval reliability

live_transport_and_worker.purpose: IANA-reserved documentation-domain transport check, not a merchant report

support: Public server-readable HTTP/HTTPS HTML/text; one selected page, robots checked, public IP/TLS/redirect/time/byte bounds
limitations: Does not render JavaScript-only pages or crawl an entire website.
Robots, login, bot challenges, files and unsafe redirects return explicit failure states.
The live transport check does not establish useful business evidence for arbitrary merchants.
Further Gemini analysis remains subject to its reviewed data policy and finite zero-cost allowance.
